name: popjam-skills
description: Generate ads, segment target audiences, and simulate reactions with synthetic personas.

interface.shortDescription: Generate ads, segment audiences, and simulate persona reactions.
interface.longDescription: Turn a campaign brief or website into target audience segments and ready-to-run ad creatives, then simulate reactions with synthetic personas to learn what resonates before launch.
defaultPrompt: Define target audience segments for my product and explain who each ad should speak to.
Turn https://popjam.io/pricing into three ready-to-test ad concepts.
Simulate how synthetic personas in my target audiences would react to this ad.
